name: Joshua Van

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (65 in height, 65 in reach, Orthodox); 125 lb at the UFC 328 and UFC 331 weigh-ins (May and Sep 2026)

photo_coverage: Good, all reference-only: Commons has no photo of him (searches for "Joshua Van" return nothing relevant), so there is nothing embeddable. 14 photos: current studio headshot and two full-body cutouts (Dec 2025, Sep 2026), a right three-quarter (Sep 2026), a high-resolution right three-quarter in the cage, a near right profile (May 2026), two weigh-in flexes, a sunglasses face-off beside Pantoja, a close lower-face presser shot, the UFC 331 celebration and two UFC 331 fight photos that show his stance. No clean left profile.

face.shape: Broad, short-to-medium face, rectangular to slightly square, widest at the cheekbones with an almost equally wide jaw; firm, fairly full cheeks, not gaunt.
face.jaw: Wide and strong with visible angles below the ears; fairly straight jawline from angle to chin.
face.chin: Broad, flat-fronted and moderately projecting; carries a small goatee tuft.
face.cheekbones: Wide and prominent, set fairly high; the midface reads broad and flat in the frontal view, with only a soft hollow below the cheekbone.
face.brow_ridge: Low to moderate; the brows sit close to the eyes.
face.forehead: Medium height and broad, smooth, with a straight front hairline slightly recessed at the corners.

eyes.shape: Narrow almond eyes with full upper lids and a low, barely visible upper-lid crease; a small fold covers the inner corners; outer corners level to slightly raised

eyebrows.shape: Straight and fairly low, tails rising very slightly; soft inner ends with a wide gap over the nose

nose.bridge: Low and broad, little projection between the eyes
nose.tip: Broad, rounded and slightly upturned, with wide, flared nostrils
nose.fight_damage: None obvious; the nose is straight in every view.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-wide mouth with full lips, the lower lip fuller; clear cupid's bow; corners level to slightly down at rest.

ears.cauliflower_ear: No: helix and antihelix are smooth on both ears (ESPN headshot zoom, Sep 2026 presser three-quarter).
ears.note: They stand slightly out from the head and read clearly because of the skin fade.

face.notable_marks_scars: A small dark mole on the right cheek beside the nose (ESPN headshot) and a light scatter of small dark spots on both cheeks (Aug 2026 close-up). Post-fight photos show swelling and redness around the eyes; no permanent scar is visible.

hair.style: Short crop: about 1-1.5 cm on top, low skin fade on the sides and back (scalp visible below the temples and around the ears), squared-off straight front hairline.
hair.colour_note: Raw sample from the top of the head in the ESPN headshot is #100b09; render as near-black with a faint warm brown sheen.
hair.hairline: Straight, slightly recessed at the temple corners

facial_hair.detail: Thin moustache along the upper lip that tapers down at the corners; small goatee under the lower lip and on the chin, joined to sparse stubble along the jawline; cheeks bare. The older UFC cutout shows a fuller goatee.
facial_hair.colour_note: The hairs are near-black; raw ESPN samples (moustache #795243, chin #573a2d) are mixed with skin because the hair is sparse.
facial_hair.shape: moustache plus chin goatee, with a thin trace of stubble on the jawline

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the face samples marked in_average (well-lit cheeks, no specular highlight, no strong colour cast); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma-percentile pixels of its patch
skin.tone_hex_recommended_method: 60% face average + 40% torso (ESPN studio cutout, same lighting setup used for all four fighters in this batch), so one whole-body tint does not come out flash-pale
skin.undertone: Warm golden-tan with an olive cast. The torso under the same studio light reads a deeper golden-brown than the flash-lit face.
skin.freckles_marks: Light scatter of small dark spots on the cheeks and a mole on the right cheek; little chest hair; dark hair on the shins and thighs.
skin.note: In the same CBS stage frame his cheeks (#c9885d, #dc9d70) sample close to Pantoja's (#da9a79, #dba17a); in the UFC 328 face-off his body reads deeper and more golden than Taira's. Excluded: the specular forehead, the over-exposed Sep 2026 presser, the dim UFC 328 weigh-in stage and a nose highlight in the AFP celebration.

body.build: Compact, muscular flyweight: 165 cm and 57 kg (125 lb) at weigh-in, thick through the chest and shoulders for the division.
body.body_fat_note: Lean with defined abs and obliques, but fuller and denser-looking than a gaunt flyweight.
body.shoulders: Broad and round for his height, with well-developed delts
body.arms: Muscular upper arms and forearms; reach equals height (165 cm), so the arms are proportionally short
body.waist: Narrow, with a clear taper from the chest
body.legs_calves: Muscular thighs and solid calves; dark leg hair
body.posture: Upright when posed with the chin slightly raised; fights in a low, wide crouch
body.notable: Thick neck and a dense upper body.

tattoos.where: chest (both pecs), upper chest to both shoulders, and sternum
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey chest piece: a pair of feathered wings spreading from the sternum toward both shoulders over sun rays; the word 'Blessed' in large script across the chest; three or four red roses with green leaves across both pecs (the only colour); praying hands with a rosary running down the sternum to the upper abdomen.

tattoos.where: left arm, full sleeve (shoulder to wrist)
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey sleeve: ornamental scroll and filigree work over the left shoulder and upper arm; script 'Joshua 1:9' on the inner arm near the elbow; roses and figurative pieces on the forearm; script 'Romans 8:31' on the outer forearm; an animal head (wolf-like) near the wrist.

tattoos.where: left side of the abdomen and left ribs
tattoos.description: Newer black-and-grey work: absent in the Dec 2025 cutout, present in Sep 2026 (ESPN cutout and UFC 331 fight photo). A shaded scene with spire-like shapes runs from below the chest piece down the left abdomen to the waistband; the subject is not legible in the photos.

tattoos_note: His right arm, the right side of the abdomen and both legs are bare. The back is not clearly seen in any photo. Sides are his own (the sleeve is image-right when he faces the camera).

kit.fight_shorts: UFC 331 (Sep 2026, red corner): red Venum shorts with a darker red geometric print, a white, gold and green animal-head graphic on his right leg and 'JOSHUA 1:9' / 'ROMANS 8:31' lettering. Dec 2025 cutout: standard white Venum shorts with the grey wave pattern. Black-and-gold at UFC 328 (per data/scouting).
kit.presser: Patterned jackets, chain necklace, sunglasses and caps at press events

stance_and_guard.observed: UFC 331 fight photos: wide, low stance with a deep knee bend and weight forward; while the left hand extends fully on the jab or hook, the right glove stays high at the right cheek with the elbow tucked to the ribs; he slips his head off the centre line to his right as he punches; chin tucked.
stance_and_guard.arms_note: The rear hand is carried at cheekbone height, glove a little forward of the face, elbow close to the body. Arms are short (reach = height), so a fully extended jab still leaves the shoulders square and close.
stance_and_guard.confidence: medium: two action photos plus the scouting file

render_hints.skin_base: young_caucasian_male (the only young-age light swatch, #e6b393) tinted toward tone_hex_recommended #bd7c58; middleage_asian_male (#dcb597) is an alternative swatch that is equally light. Texture picked by age and swatch colour only.
render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow010 tinted #1c1512, kept straight and low

ethnicity_fit.basis: Fitted by eye to how MakeHuman's three shape bases reproduce what the photos show: a broad, flat midface with wide cheekbones, a low and broad nasal bridge with a broad rounded tip, a low upper-lid crease with a small inner-corner fold, and full lips. Not assigned from name or nationality.
ethnicity_fit.confidence: low-to-medium: check a render against espn_headshot.png and the UFC 328 profile; the detail morphs below are kept moderate so the sheet still works if this block is removed

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set; they are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs.

morphs_unavailable: No target for the skin fade, the thin moustache-and-goatee pattern or the eyelid crease itself (epicanthus-in and height2 only approximate it); the tattoos need texture work.
notes: Confidence: high for the overall look (broad square face, short crop with skin fade, narrow hooded eyes under straight low brows, broad low-bridged nose, full lips, thin moustache and goatee, 'Blessed' chest piece plus LEFT-arm sleeve, compact thick build); medium for the exact morph values. Watch for: (1) the face is broad and flat through the cheekbones, so a narrow or long head loses him at once; (2) keep the eyes narrow with full lids; over-opened eyes are the most common miss; (3) the nose bridge is low and the tip broad and a little upturned, with no hump; (4) the sleeve is on his LEFT arm and the new abdomen work is on his LEFT side; the right arm is bare; (5) the body tint should be deeper than a flash-lit face suggests (use tone_hex_recommended); (6) macro/heightDownM uses heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 = -0.31 from research/assets.md, the same value as Pantoja's 165 cm sheet; measure the mesh and nudge it to 165 cm. ageOldM is 0 because he turned 25 on Oct 10, 2026 (avatar3d.js age mapping). The ethnicity_fit block is opt-in for avatar3d.js; drop it if the orchestrator wants the neutral thirds kept.
